name: claude-influxdb3
description: Teach Claude Code to write correct InfluxDB 3 code (connect, write, query, schema design), to develop, install, and test Processing Engine plugins, to provision and manage databases and auth tokens, AND to troubleshoot when something stops working — for InfluxDB 3 Core and InfluxDB 3 Enterprise, with routing for other InfluxDB 3 products, in Python, JavaScript, Go, Java, C#, and raw HTTP.
